title: CooperativeDAO
tagline: Cooperatives are a physical representation of DAOs. Just created a DAO for my cooperative to try out.
description:
Changing governance structure of an existing DAO to suit the 6 core values of cooperatives: self-help, self-responsibility, democracy, equality, equity, and solidarity.

I want to show cooperatives that they can create greater engagement in their membership in voting if they adopt new tools.
how_its_made:
I have used an existing DAO template from NEAR for the basis of the cooperative physical cooperative DAO. 

Currently trying to create a simple version of a DAO that all cooperative members, like myself, who is not super technical in web3, can adopt and use with their general membership right away.
